clue.text: Broadcaster has quarrel regarding west-facing building

parts.note: Sky is the British satellite broadcaster
a scrap is a fight or quarrel

indicators.note: in an across clue, facing west means read right to left, so the word for regarding runs backwards

parts.note: RE is Latin-derived shorthand for regarding or concerning

explanation.surface: A TV company has a row about a building whose front faces west.
explanation.walkthrough: 'west-facing' turns RE into ER at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A very tall office or apartment tower is a type of building, a straightforward example.

clue.text: Lay off dry white wine

definitions.meaning: to dismiss a worker from a job
an old name for a dry fortified white wine from Spain, as in Falstaff's favourite drink

explanation.surface: An employer cuts staff, or a drink order is placed.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are dictionary meanings: dismissal from employment, and the historical name of a sherry-like dry wine.

clue.text: Child's potty gone rusty

indicators.note: potty means crazy, so the letters of the following words go mad and are rearranged

explanation.surface: A child's potty has corroded with age.
explanation.walkthrough: 'potty' looks like the child's toilet, but here it is the slang adjective for crazy, signalling the anagram; the 's is a link meaning 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A youngster is a young person, so a synonym for a kid.

clue.text: The man's in court for a case

indicators.note: in places the contraction inside the abbreviation for court

parts.note: the man is, contracted, gives he's

explanation.surface: A man appears in court to argue his case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'case' looks like a legal case, but it is a box.
explanation.definitionFit: A strongbox or trunk for storing things is a kind of case, as in a tea chest.

clue.text: A rising artist restricted by shortcoming: greed

indicators.note: restricted by means held inside the word for shortcoming

parts.note: a vice is a moral failing or shortcoming

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the letters read upwards, i.e. backwards

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword staple for artist

explanation.surface: An up-and-coming painter is held back by a single flaw: greed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' reads upward in a down clue, so the artist's letters run backwards; RA for a Royal Academician is a standard crossword abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Avarice is the extreme desire for wealth, a direct synonym for covetousness.

clue.text: Tied up or about to tie the knot

definitions.meaning: busy or occupied, as a phone line is

explanation.surface: Someone is busy or about to marry.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both occupied (a busy line) and betrothed, two standard dictionary senses.

clue.text: Senior's outraged? Not half!

indicators.note: not half means keep only the back half of the word outraged, dropping its first half

explanation.surface: Is the old person furious? Very much so, as the slang 'not half' says.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not half!' is British slang for 'absolutely', but here it removes the first half of OUTRAGED; the 's is a link meaning 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Old or elderly, which describes a senior citizen, a near synonym.

clue.text: Information about literary style

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
RE means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Details concerning a writer's manner.
explanation.definitionFit: A category of writing such as romance or crime is a kind of literary style.

clue.text: Upset, pa's despair fades away

indicators.note: upset means knocked over, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A father's hopelessness lifts once he is upset.
explanation.walkthrough: The S of 'pa's' is part of the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: To vanish is to fade away, a direct synonym.

clue.text: About to apply reason

parts.note: CA stands for circa, Latin for about
to use something is to apply it

explanation.surface: Someone is about to put a reason to work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About to' reads as 'on the point of', but 'About' gives CA and 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The motive or ground for something is its reason, a synonym.

clue.text: Exchanges knitted garment with us

indicators.note: knitted means interwoven, so the letters are worked together into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone swaps a hand-knitted jumper with us.
explanation.definitionFit: Heated exchanges of words are rows or disputes, a common sense.

clue.text: Annie perhaps makes false claim about American

indicators.note: about means placed around the abbreviation for American
false means not genuine, so the letters of the word claim are rearranged

parts.note: US is the United States, so American

explanation.surface: Annie, a girl, lies about an American.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Annie' looks like a person's name, but it is the title of a Broadway show; 'false' reworks the letters of the word claim, which split around the American abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Annie is a famous stage show with songs, so an example of the category; 'perhaps' marks it.

clue.text: Earning from gambling, good for bishop

indicators.note: good for bishop means the letter for good replaces the letter for bishop

parts.note: betting is gambling
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: Someone makes money from gambling, which is fine for a cleric.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting money is earning or acquiring it, a synonym.

clue.text: Son starts to look extremely exhausted — prompting this?

definitions.text: Son starts to look extremely exhausted — prompting this?

indicators.note: starts to means take the opening letter of each of the next four words

explanation.surface: A boy looks completely worn out, which suggests what he needs.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the wordplay and a description of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A worn-out child needs rest; the clue describes what extreme tiredness prompts.

clue.text: Clumsily move ahead of sailor? Hazel's possibly knocked down by him

definitions.text: Hazel's possibly knocked down by him

indicators.note: ahead of puts the first piece before the next in a down answer

parts.note: to lumber is to move heavily and awkwardly
jack, as in jack tar, is a sailor

explanation.surface: A man stumbles toward a sailor, while a tree is felled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hazel' looks like a woman's name, but it is a tree, as the question mark and 'possibly' hint.
explanation.definitionFit: A tree feller cuts down trees such as hazel, an example rather than a synonym.

clue.text: Free drink after one drops one!

indicators.note: after places the word for drink following the shortened piece
drops means lets fall, so the letter is removed from the word

parts.note: a unit is a single thing, one
I is the Roman numeral for one
wine is a drink

explanation.surface: A free drink is offered once someone has knocked one back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drops' takes I out of UNIT to give UNT.
explanation.definitionFit: To unravel two twisted strands is to free or disentangle them, a verb sense.

clue.text: Hangers-on that are frozen out?

parts.note: spongers cold-shouldered from a group, but literally frozen things that hang from eaves outdoors

explanation.surface: Freeloaders get excluded from a social circle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hangers-on' and 'frozen out' both sound social, but read literally they describe frozen drips hanging outside.
explanation.definitionFit: Spikes of ice hang from gutters in cold weather, so they literally hang on and are frozen outdoors.

clue.text: State cleared criminal

indicators.note: criminal means wrong or bent, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The state frees a criminal.
explanation.definitionFit: To state is to announce or affirm formally, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Promoting a volume about discoing? On the contrary

indicators.note: about would put the dance word around the volume letter
on the contrary flips the stated relation, so the dance word goes around the volume letter instead

parts.note: discoing is dancing at a disco

explanation.surface: Someone promotes a book about disco dancing.
explanation.walkthrough: Read straight, V would go round DANCING; 'On the contrary' swaps that, so DANCING goes round V after its D.
explanation.definitionFit: Promoting someone is moving them forward or up, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Bride's upset about invitations, initially — they're below par

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters go around the next piece
upset means overturned, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the S of the possessive is part of the fodder here

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of the word invitations

explanation.surface: A bride is upset about her wedding invitations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'below par' sounds like feeling ill, but it is a golf term.
explanation.definitionFit: In golf, a hole completed one stroke under par is scored this way, so it is literally below par.

clue.text: Peculiar ice in drinks all overturned

indicators.note: all overturned means the whole combination is turned upside down, read upwards in a down clue
in places the word ice inside the word for drinks

parts.note: a cat laps milk, so laps means drinks

explanation.surface: Odd ice cubes in drinks that have all been knocked over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'all overturned' turns the whole assembly upside down, not just the drinks; laps means drinks as a cat does.
explanation.definitionFit: Special can mean particular to one thing, as peculiar does in 'peculiar to'.

clue.text: Endure sitting in the German express

indicators.note: sitting in places the word for endure inside the German article

parts.note: der is a German word for the
to live through something is to endure it

explanation.surface: Putting up with a seat on the German express train.
explanation.walkthrough: 'express' looks like a train, but it is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To express a speech or opinion is to utter or hand it over, as one delivers a verdict.

clue.text: Deputy closes banks

parts.note: to close is to end; closes means ends

explanation.surface: A deputy shuts down banks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'banks' looks like financial institutions, but it is a verb, as in 'banks on'.
explanation.definitionFit: To bank on something is to rely on it, which is the sense of 'depends on'.

clue.text: Royal appears in picture gallery

indicators.note: appears in means the letters show up inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A monarch is shown in a portrait gallery.
explanation.definitionFit: Regal means befitting a monarch, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Street urchin: a male consumed by alcohol

indicators.note: consumed by means swallowed inside the word for alcohol

parts.note: gin is an alcoholic spirit

explanation.surface: A ragged child, a man swallowed up by drink.
explanation.definitionFit: The French-derived word names a mischievous ragamuffin child of the streets.

clue.text: Describe former lover? Unattractive

parts.note: an ex is a former partner
plain means homely or unattractive

explanation.surface: Someone is asked to describe their ex, who is not good-looking.
explanation.definitionFit: To describe something is to set it out clearly, a near synonym.

clue.text: Cancel a Northern university being hosted by the Netherlands

indicators.note: being hosted by means taken in as a guest inside the country code

parts.note: NL is the international code for the Netherlands

explanation.surface: A northern university's event in the Netherlands is cancelled.
explanation.definitionFit: To annul a marriage or contract is to declare it void, a synonym.

clue.text: Reduce study temperature

parts.note: a den is a private room, a study

explanation.surface: Turning down the heat in the study.
explanation.definitionFit: To make a dent in savings is to reduce them, an idiomatic sense.

clue.text: A daughter calling for permission to enter

parts.note: a mission is a vocation or calling

explanation.surface: A daughter asks for leave to come in.
explanation.definitionFit: Being allowed entry to a place or club is the right of entrance, a synonym.

clue.text: Gullible citizen ignoring Brexit's conclusion

indicators.note: ignoring means leaving out a letter from the word for citizen

parts.note: a native is a citizen born in a place

indicators.note: conclusion means the final letter of the word Brexit

explanation.surface: A credulous citizen who disregards how Brexit ended.
explanation.definitionFit: An innocent, trusting person is easily fooled, so gullible is a synonym.

clue.text: Child taken round new class

indicators.note: taken round means the word for child goes around the letter for new

parts.note: a kid is a child

explanation.surface: A child is shown round a new classroom.
explanation.definitionFit: A kind is a sort or category, so a synonym for class.

clue.text: Torch is snazzy and easy to carry

parts.note: flash is British slang for showy or snazzy
something light weighs little, so is easy to carry

explanation.surface: A torch is described as stylish and portable.
explanation.walkthrough: In British English a torch is a battery-powered hand lamp, not a flaming brand.
explanation.definitionFit: The British torch is the American name's equivalent, a portable battery lamp.
